summary: Comprehensive DFR testing (backend + frontend). 12/12 pytest backend tests PASS covering CRUD, idempotent POST, access control (owner/admin vs regular user), ?all=1 listing, and xlsx export (headers, black/white bold styling, D9D9D9 alternating rows, numeric cells). 15/15 frontend flows PASS via Playwright: Export dropdown → DFR nav, pre-filled row (date=today, SOW/JobType=OCALC, Address=24810 Majestic Cone Lane), 18-name synapsiq fielder select with no old byers names, autosave + 'Saved' indicator + reload persistence (FTH/0.75/34), travel-hr options (0..16 step 0.25, 66 values incl placeholder), miles options (0..500, 502 values), Add row with job pick auto-fills SOW/Address, Remove row with confirm, GPS 4-phase progression Start→Arrived→Leaving→Stop autofills work/return/miles=0, Reset GPS, Travel Map dialog with job-ID pin label 'A050ABC', Full Day/Per Job mode switch, Screenshot PNG download (Travel_Map_2026-10-03_A050ABC.png), xlsx download (Daily_Field_Report_2026-10-03.xlsx), Mobile 390px horizontal scroll without body overflow (body=390=viewport, table scrollWidth=3032).
critical_code_review_comments: field_reports.py:67-79 — POST idempotency returns 201 even for existing report; acceptable per spec ('creates (201) and a second POST for same user+date returns the existing report') but technically 200 would be more RESTful for the second call. Current impl works.

field_reports.py:88-93 — PUT does not restrict date change; a user could PUT with a different date and collide with another of their own reports. Not currently enforced via unique index on (user_id, date). Low priority.
DFRTable.jsx — Travel hours select includes an empty option labelled '—' as first entry (66 options total). Matches spec intent (allow blank) — not an issue, just noting for test authors.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create then delete DFRs on dates 2030-01-15 and 2030-01-16 for admin user; cleaned up by fixture teardown. Frontend tests used Admin's live DFR for today's date (2026-10-03) which was pre-existing from smoke test; final state after tests: market=FTH, travel=0.75, miles=34, with autosaved row for seed job A050ABC.
context_for_next_testing_agent: DFR feature fully implemented and working end-to-end. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_field_reports_dfr.py — rerun with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env set. Frontend test IDs confirmed: dfr-page, dfr-table, dfr-table-wrap, dfr-report-date, dfr-report-fielder, dfr-add-row-btn, dfr-travel-map-btn, dfr-export-xlsx-btn, dfr-date-N, dfr-job-N, dfr-market-N, dfr-sow-N, dfr-jobtype-N, dfr-address-N, dfr-fielder-N, dfr-travel-N, dfr-work-N, dfr-return-N, dfr-miles-N, dfr-footage-N, dfr-poles-N, dfr-computer-N, dfr-status-N, dfr-comments-N, dfr-remove-row-N, dfr-track-row-N, dfr-travel-tracker, dfr-travel-start-btn, dfr-arrived-btn, dfr-leaving-btn, dfr-stop-btn, dfr-gps-reset, dfr-travel-map-dialog, dfr-map-mode, dfr-map-screenshot-btn, dfr-pin-label-N, dfr-ro-row-N. The GPS tracker requires radio-row activation (dfr-track-row-0) before Start Travel is enabled — this is correct behaviour per the implementation (disabled={!enabled || !activeRow}). Login button text is 'Sign In' (not 'Login'). Employee list for New Job dialog uses shadcn Select (data-testid='job-employee-select' on trigger, not a native select) — contents come from the SAME ASE_OPTIONS.employees array that drives the DFR fielder select, which we verified has 18 synapsiq.com entries and zero old byers names (John Sydow/Maier/Adrianson/Horton all absent).
